badge: Primary Brief — AI for Peace (Harlem ↔ Nairobi)
title: [SYNTHETIC DEMO] 1969 Harlem–Nairobi Cultural Peace Exchange
description: Two community archives describe the same cross-cultural peace gathering. They agree on the event title, venue, and keynote speaker, but disagree on the start date and attendee numbers, while each records a unique source-exclusive detail.

sources.label: Harlem Living Archive (Synthetic Record A)
sources.raw_text: [SYNTHETIC ARCHIVE A] The Transatlantic Cultural Peace Exchange convened at the Harlem Community Arts Hall on 1969-08-12. Keynote speaker Dr. Marcus Kwame addressed 450 registered delegates. The delegates signed the Harlem-Nairobi Cultural Solidarity Accord.

structured_claims.original_text: The Transatlantic Cultural Peace Exchange convened...
Keynote speaker Dr. Marcus Kwame addressed...
The delegates signed the Harlem-Nairobi Cultural Solidarity Accord.

sources.label: Nairobi Oral History Chronicle (Synthetic Record B)
sources.raw_text: [SYNTHETIC ARCHIVE B] Oral history tape #14 recalls the Transatlantic Cultural Peace Exchange at the Harlem Community Arts Hall beginning on 1969-08-19. Dr. Marcus Kwame delivered the keynote speech before an estimated crowd of 600 attendees. The session was preserved on East African Magnetic Reel #14.

structured_claims.original_text: Dr. Marcus Kwame delivered the keynote speech...
The session was preserved on East African Magnetic Reel #14.
